messages:
Emily Chen: Heads-up — ACME wants an air‑gapped Private deployment but also expects standard Dedicated pricing and a clause that disallows outbound egress for 3 years. asking if we can fit this into a standard package or if it requires a custom contract.
Raj Patel: Do we know if they need reserved capacity (dedicated GPUs) or just a private control plane?
Emily Chen: They want reserved capacity + customer-managed networking. Essentially Private with Dedicated economics. main ask: no external traffic and an indemnity carveout.
Maya Ortiz: Sales flag — this is a 50-seat+ deal, likely enterprise. ACME will walk if we require an enterprise-only private license. can we propose an "Airgap + Compliance" add-on instead of full custom? :thinking:
Leo Zhang: From eng: air‑gapped installs are doable but ops+support cost goes up ~30%. also some features (streaming webhooks, telemetry) need gated fallbacks.
Samir Gupta (Legal): We need to see the exact indemnity language. absolute "no egress" is doable but we should include telemetry opt‑in clauses and security review SLAs. I can draft a sample clause.
Raj Patel: Pricing-wise we could treat it as: base Private fee + airgap premium (flat monthly) + reserved GPU commit. avoids per-token complexity for them. keeps our unit economics sane.
Maya Ortiz: Customer will push back on large flat fees. they prefer predictable committed units. can we offer a blended model: annual commit (GPU hour equivalent) + smaller flat airgap surcharge?
Leo Zhang: Implementation constraints: if we do blended pricing we must surface quotas in the Console and disable streaming webhooks. estimating 4 sprints to add feature flags + config UI + rollout tests.
Emily Chen: Launch criteria to propose: (1) documented OPS runbook for airgap installs, (2) telemetry opt‑in toggle validated, (3) pricing term template for legal. if those 3 are green, we can offer as add‑on.
Samir Gupta (Legal): Draft clause (starter):
```
Customer shall deploy the Redwood Private runtime within an isolated network with no outbound network egress to public internet except for optional, auditable telemetry endpoints. Redwood shall provide a telemetry opt‑in mechanism. Any data transfer to Redwood-controlled endpoints shall be subject to Customer approval and listed in Annex A.
```
I'll refine with liability limits.
Maya Ortiz: Suggest adding a launch SLA: 99.5% availability for dedicated pool; support response TTR 4 hours for P1 during business hours. will this be acceptable?
Leo Zhang: 99.5% on dedicated pools is ok. but for airgap installs we need an on-site or VPN support playbook — adds cost.
Raj Patel: Proposal summary we can send ACME: "Private + Reserved GPUs + Airgap Add‑on" with pricing cells: annual GPU commit (units), airgap surcharge (flat % of commit or fixed $), and optional Premium Support. attach rollout timeline (8 weeks).
Maya Ortiz: I'll pilot that with ACME tomorrow. can someone produce the pricing cells and the runbook checklist by EOD? :pray:
Leo Zhang: I'll drop a short runbook checklist in this thread by 5pm.
Samir Gupta (Legal): I'll share a contract template with redlines by EOD as well.
contract-bot: Reminder — attach NDA or redline via ContractHub when ready.
Emily Chen: Awesome. after we have the runbook + pricing + redline, we'll do a quick gating doc for PM review. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
